component.name: Heronite
component.summary: Every game you own, on Linux, in one native launcher

description.p: Heronite gathers your games from Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon Games, Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect and Rockstar Games, plus emulated ROMs and native Linux and Windows games, in one Collection, and launches them natively, with Wine or Proton, or through an emulator.

ul.li: Install, update and repair Epic, GOG and Amazon games from one download queue
Statuses, ratings, playtime, sessions, statistics and a year in review
Metadata and artwork from IGDB, SteamGridDB, Steam and Lutris
Wine and Proton manager, save backups with Ludusavi
Emulator detection, ROM folder scanning and RetroAchievements
A controller-first console mode with shareable themes
